title.narrative: Enterprise Development and Innovation Facility (EDIF) - Guarantee Facility -Youth Employment (“WB EDIF GF Youth”)

description.narrative: Replanishment of the existing EDIF Guarantee Facility (GF) of the Western Balkan Enterprise Development and Innovation Facility. Under the present Agreement, the EIF is going to continue managing the Guarantee Facility component of WB EDIF, by also including youth employment and training specific guarantees. This is the third replenishment of the GF.
